title: A story of sustained effort that omits what renews its members makes the commitment read as tactics rather than values
body:
- A story of sustained collective action that omits what renews its members between actions makes the actors' commitments read as tactics rather than values.
- Reflective or spiritual moments in the narrative show what renews participants between confrontations with opposing systems.
- Showing both action and renewal preserves the movement's coherence and keeps activists from burning out.
conversion: The sustained commitment reads as tactics rather than the values that drive it
